screening.reason: Inclusion 2,3: reports a resting-state fMRI group-difference (ASD vs TD) analysis; the original 21-ASD cohort is the authors' own (non-ABIDE) sample, but a 42 ASD / 88 TD replication cohort is drawn directly from ABIDE II resting-state data with an explicit site-selection and QC rule.

evidence_spans.text: extracted from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) II
evidence_spans.claim: The study's replication cohort is drawn from ABIDE II.

evidence_spans.text: The ABIDE II consists of datasets from 487 individuals with ASD and 557 controls collected across 16 imaging sites.
evidence_spans.claim: States the full ABIDE II release size and number of sites.

evidence_spans.text: in order to collect samples similar to our original samples, we selected subjects who met following criteria: boys with FSIQ ≥80, age range: 6–16 years, right handed, with scores recorded on the SRS
evidence_spans.claim: Explicit selection rule applied to the ABIDE II subset (sex, FSIQ, age, handedness, behavioural-score availability).

evidence_spans.text: Since no participants in the NYU_2 dataset had complete cerebellar coverage, this dataset was excluded. In addition, participants with excessive maximum head motion (>3 mm) or failure of normalization were excluded.
evidence_spans.claim: Additional exclusion rules (imaging coverage, motion >3mm, normalization failure) applied to the ABIDE II subset.

evidence_spans.text: The ﬁnal replication dataset consisted of 42 boys with ASD (mean age: 10.7 ± 1.8 years, range: 7.2–14.4 years) and 88 TD boys
evidence_spans.claim: Final analysed ABIDE II N: 42 ASD, 88 TD.

evidence_spans.text: Preprocessing for functional images consisted of realignment for motion correction, slice-timing correction, normalization to the standard MNI space, and smoothing with a 4-mm full width at half- maximum ﬁlter.
Seed ROIs in the cerebellum were created using the probabilistic MR Atlas of the human cerebellum
evidence_spans.claim: Parcellation used is a cerebellar seed atlas (Diedrichsen probabilistic atlas), not a whole-brain functional atlas.

evidence_spans.text: mean FD scores were included as a nuisance covariate in t-tests. In addition, FSIQ and imaging sites were included as nuisance covariates. Bonferroni correction was performed for multiple comparisons (p = 0.004).
evidence_spans.claim: Site and motion were handled as covariates; multiple comparisons corrected by Bonferroni in the replication analysis.

evidence_spans.text: decreased FCs were identiﬁed between the following regions: the right lobule IX and right lobule VI; vermis VI and left MFG, left ITG, and right MdFG; right dentate nucleus and left IFG, left IPL
evidence_spans.claim: Original-dataset finding: mixture of increased and decreased cerebellar-cerebral connectivity in ASD.

evidence_spans.text: the ASD group showed signiﬁcantly decreased FC between the right dentate nucleus and left IPL (p = 0.039, Figure 4)
evidence_spans.claim: One of the 12 original findings (dentate nucleus-left IPL decreased FC) was replicated in the ABIDE II sample.

assessments.support: "we selected subjects who met following criteria: boys with FSIQ ≥80, age range: 6–16 years, right handed, with scores recorded on the SRS" plus motion/coverage exclusions reported.
Per-site N and demographics reported for the five selected ABIDE II sites (GU, KKI, NYU_1, NYU_2, SDSU).

"Preprocessing for functional images consisted of realignment for motion correction, slice-timing correction, normalization to the standard MNI space, and smoothing with a 4-mm full width at half- maximum ﬁlter."
"Diagnosis of ASD was made using ADOS-G or ADOS-2 (Lord et al., 2012)."
"mean FD scores were included as a nuisance covariate in t-tests. In addition, FSIQ and imaging sites were included as nuisance covariates."
Same quote: FD, FSIQ and site entered as covariates; group difference in FD tested and found non-significant ("There were no signiﬁcant diﬀerences between groups in mean FD scores (p = 0.140)").
"Correlation coeﬃcients were converted to normally distributed Z-scores using Fisher’s transformation"

"All results were reported using a voxel-height threshold set at uncorrected p < 0.001, with a cluster-extent threshold at a FDR-corrected p < 0.05" and Bonferroni correction for the ROI-to-ROI replication test.

risk_of_bias.summary: Well-described cohort, pipeline, diagnosis source and covariate handling for the ABIDE II replication subset; main limitation is a small replication effect (only 1/12 findings surviving Bonferroni correction, one trend-level).

charting.feature_extraction_tools: CONN toolbox with SPM12 (realignment, slice-timing correction, normalization to MNI, 4mm FWHM smoothing, CompCor nuisance regression, band-pass 0.008-0.09 Hz)
charting.specific_features: Seed-to-voxel / ROI-to-ROI functional connectivity using cerebellar seed ROIs from the Diedrichsen probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum
charting.features_associated_disorder: Cerebellar hemispheric (Crus I/II, lobules VI/IX) and vermal (VI, VIIIa, VIIIb, X) and right dentate nucleus connectivity with cerebral regions (insula, MFG, SMG, AG, MTG, ITG, IFG, IPL, MdFG)
charting.feature_change_direction: Mixed: increased FC between cerebellar Crus I/II and vermis regions with insula/MFG/SMG/AG/MTG; decreased FC between lobule IX-VI, vermis VI, and right dentate nucleus with IFG/IPL/ITG/MdFG; decreased FC between right dentate nucleus and left IPL replicated in ABIDE II (p=0.039)
charting.dataset_openly_available: Not reported for this paper's own analysis code or participant list; selection rules and per-site Ns are given in text and Supplementary Table S1

custom_fields.RQ1: ABIDE II used as a replication cohort (not the primary dataset): 5 of 16 ABIDE II sites selected (GU, KKI, NYU_1, NYU_2, SDSU) with sex/FSIQ/age/handedness/behavioural-score filters, then NYU_2 and motion/normalization failures excluded, yielding 42 ASD and 88 TD boys. | quote: "The ﬁnal replication dataset consisted of 42 boys with ASD (mean age: 10.7 ± 1.8 years, range: 7.2–14.4 years) and 88 TD boys"
custom_fields.RQ2: CONN toolbox/SPM12 pipeline (realignment, slice-timing, MNI normalization, 4mm smoothing, CompCor); cerebellar seed ROIs from the Diedrichsen probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum, not a whole-brain parcellation. | quote: "Seed ROIs in the cerebellum were created using the probabilistic MR Atlas of the human cerebellum"
custom_fields.RQ3: associational — group-difference analysis of ASD vs TD cerebellar-cerebral connectivity, with a replication test in ABIDE II; no classifier or prediction model. | quote: "The ASD group showed signiﬁcantly increased or decreased FCs between the cerebellar subregions and cerebral cortices, relative to the TD group in the original dataset."
custom_fields.RQ4: Two-sample t-tests on ROI-to-ROI connectivity; mean FD, FSIQ and imaging site included as nuisance covariates; Bonferroni correction (p=0.004) in the ABIDE II replication test; original dataset used voxel-height p<0.001 with FDR-corrected cluster threshold p<0.05. | quote: "mean FD scores were included as a nuisance covariate in t-tests. In addition, FSIQ and imaging sites were included as nuisance covariates. Bonferroni correction was performed for multiple comparisons (p = 0.004)."
custom_fields.RQ5: Of the 12 aberrant cerebellar-cerebral FCs found in the original (non-ABIDE) dataset, decreased FC between right dentate nucleus and left IPL replicated significantly in the ABIDE II sample (p=0.039), with a non-significant trend for vermis VI-left MFG (p=0.071) that did not survive Bonferroni correction. | quote: "the ASD group showed signiﬁcantly decreased FC between the right dentate nucleus and left IPL (p = 0.039, Figure 4)"

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Group-difference (associational) study; original non-ABIDE cohort (21 ASD/24 TD, Japan) plus an ABIDE II replication cohort of 42 ASD / 88 TD boys drawn from 5 sites (GU, KKI, NYU_1, NYU_2 [excluded], SDSU)
narrative_row.methods: Seed-based ROI-to-ROI resting-state functional connectivity from cerebellar subregions (Diedrichsen probabilistic atlas) to cerebral cortex, using CONN toolbox/SPM12 preprocessing; two-sample t-tests with FD, FSIQ and site as covariates, FDR-corrected (original) / Bonferroni-corrected (replication) thresholds
narrative_row.outcomes: 12 cerebellar-cerebral FC group differences found in the original dataset (mixed increased/decreased); one (right dentate nucleus-left IPL decreased FC, p=0.039) replicated significantly in ABIDE II; FC values correlated with motor, executive and socio-communicative measures in the original dataset
narrative_row.key_limitations: Small original sample; only partial replication in ABIDE II (1/12 findings surviving correction); no code or participant-list release found
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Demonstrates use of a specific ABIDE II site/criteria subset purely as an independent replication sample for an externally-derived finding, with exact numeric selection rules reported.

kg_link.cohort_description: 5 of 16 ABIDE II sites selected (GU, KKI, NYU_1, NYU_2, SDSU) for boys with FSIQ>=80, age 6-16, right-handed, with SRS/SRS2/BRIEF scores; NYU_2 excluded for incomplete cerebellar coverage; further excluded for head motion >3mm or normalization failure
kg_link.sites: 5 of 16 ABIDE II sites (GU, KKI, NYU_1, NYU_2 [excluded], SDSU)
kg_link.pipeline: CONN toolbox + SPM12 (realignment, slice-timing correction, MNI normalization, 4mm FWHM smoothing, CompCor nuisance regression, band-pass 0.008-0.09Hz)
kg_link.atlas: Diedrichsen probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum (seed ROIs), cerebral targets from whole-brain voxelwise/cluster analysis
kg_link.finding: Of 12 cerebellar-cerebral functional connectivity differences found between ASD and TD in the original (non-ABIDE) sample, decreased FC between the right dentate nucleus and left IPL replicated significantly in the ABIDE II sample (p=0.039)
